model.basis: Minutes for a learner who has finished the six covered topic pages. Reading and writing times use the frozen page estimator rates (200 words per minute, 15 code lines per minute) for the README and worked example, plus authoring time per file judged from the size of each file in two independently written private solutions (backend Dockerfile 12-13 lines, frontend Dockerfile 8-9 lines, compose.yaml 30-40 lines).

phases.phase: 5 runbook.yaml (nine commands) and its four tests

model.wrongFirstRetry: each of the 20 tests failing once after the first attempt costs about 1 minute to read the message, fix and rerun; a typical learner meets 4 to 6 such retries, already inside phase 4
model.worstRequiredBasis: typical 87 plus about 24 minutes for every one of the six file groups (backend Dockerfile, frontend Dockerfile, backend .dockerignore, frontend .dockerignore, compose.yaml with .env and .gitignore, runbook.yaml) failing twice before passing (two retries of about 2 minutes each per group)
model.fit: Each Standard Lab day has an 85-minute guided-lab block (frozen calendar Lab template); the S36 (42, worst 58) and S37 (45, worst 53) shares each fit inside one block
model.extension: 2026-11-17: phase 5 (runbook.yaml, tests 17 to 20) added for the coverage-gap objectives; its 12 minutes are modeled from nine one-line commands plus one env-file line, at the same rates, not observed. Labelled in the README as an authoring estimate, not a measured learner pilot.
model.splitBasis: S36 = setup 3 + phase 1 5 + phase 2 10 + backend Dockerfile 12 + frontend Dockerfile 8 + .dockerignore files 4 = 42; S37 = compose.yaml, .env and .gitignore 18 + phase 4 15 + phase 5 12 = 45

worstPerDay.basis: S36 42 plus four file groups x 4 = 16; S37 45 plus two file groups x 4 = 8; each day stays at 60 minutes or less

learnerCommands.note: wall-clock /usr/bin/time real seconds for the commands in lab.json; the cold npm ci run used an empty npm cache (2026-10-15); the test runs were re-measured on 2026-11-17 against the 20-test lab

projectBuildability.note: not part of the learner test command; run once in private staging to show the starter projects really build, with no container engine
projectBuildability.mavenResult: ./mvnw -q dependency:go-offline, then ./mvnw -q -o package -DskipTests, produced target/shop-api-0.0.1.jar on JDK 25
projectBuildability.frontendResult: npm ci, then npm run build, wrote dist/index.html and dist/assets

notObserved: No human learner has been timed. The phase minutes below are a model, not an observation.
